result.violated_requirement: The vending machine must retain its accumulated balance (next-state hold) when no currency is inserted; it must not abandon the accumulated state until a beverage is dispensed or selected.
result.spec_basis: Spec: 'The machine accumulates the total amount of money inserted' plus 'Each currency input produces a pulse signal that goes high on clock rising edge and low on clock falling edge' (momentary pulses require the state/balance to persist between clock cycles, not fall back to the initial state on idle cycles).
